html:
Come with Vietlook Travel to discover the beauty of Ha Long caves, you will feel the natural beauty, with the mysterious and majestic will bring you unique experiences in the island paradise, especially in the summer when the weather in the North is hot, Ha Long brings visitors cool spaces, especially when going by boat to explore the beauty of the caves.

Ha Long is not only known for its beautiful stops, but also for its mysterious caves, including Sung Sot Cave, Luon Cave, Dau Go Cave, Trong Cave…

When talking about Ha Long, tourists not only know about the islands hidden in the middle of the ocean, surrounded by high, undulating rocky mountains, but also visit the mysterious caves when traveling to Ha Long.

Sung Sot Cave

The cave is located on Ho Bo Island, a large cave with beautiful stalactites and stalagmites, and there are stalactites that look like beautiful animals.

As one of the limestone caves of Bo Hon Island, Ha Long Bay, Hang Hang Sot consists of 2 main compartments with a short head and a ceiling filled with stalactites that look very unique. To reach the cave, you have to climb 50 stone steps while watching the forest canopy surrounding a peaceful scene.

The second compartment of the cave is one of the wild scenes, however, when going deep inside the cave, you will encounter stone slabs with unique shapes that will make you feel excited.

Luon Cave

The cave has its own beauty, right from the cave entrance, visitors will encounter an unusual beauty, the cave has a very cool arc shape, a beautiful sunny spot on summer days.

To get to the cave, visitors should experience it on a kayak or a small boat, which is an indispensable destination in the summer Ha Long tour itinerary.

Dau Go Cave

The cave is divided into 3 compartments, each compartment exudes its own beauty, with multi-colored rocks, right at the cave entrance there are rays of sunlight shining in, exuding a beauty that brings excitement to visitors.

It can be said that Dau Go Cave is a masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon Ha Long, surrounded by a magnificent space, the cave is located next to Thien Cung Cave. To reach the cave, you have to cross 90 stone steps, inside the cave are stalactites reflecting a unique beauty.

Trong Cave and Trinh Nu Cave

Coming here, visitors not only explore the beauty of the cave but also hear thrilling stories, to get to the cave, visitors will experience it on luxurious Ha Long cruise ships and when entering the cave, visitors will feel the coolness, with colorful stalactites.

Thien Canh Son Cave

The cave is located right in Ha Long Bay and Bai Tu Long, surrounded by wild scenery, inside there are beautiful stalactites, looking like animals, visitors can record beautiful pictures when exploring Ha Long Cave.

Coming here, you will feel the beauty of a fairyland, inside the cave there are unique shaped rocks, looking like lotus flowers or animals, with sparkling stalactites, to reach the cave you have to conquer 100 stone steps, but when you step into the cave, you will see a magnificent beauty that will make you feel amazed.

It can be said that the natural wonder of the world in Ha Long with beautiful stops, and mysterious caves with thrilling stories, inside the cave there are many beautiful stalactites with stalagmites that look like animals. According to the Ha Long tour in the summer, visitors will immerse themselves in the colorful natural picture, and explore the magical beauty of the sea and islands.
